free_text: The 68-year-old male has a PSA of 6.7 and a cT1c prostate cancer, with a PI-RADS 4 lesion identified on MRI. Histologically, the disease remains Gleason 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1). Given the moderate LUTS (IPSS 16/35) and the need to weigh treatment versus surveillance, the management assessment is active surveillance pending clinical review of individual treatment benefit and patient preferences.
